verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic receipt capture tied to card swipes, with memos and categories filled in, and automated reminders for missing items. The CLI also exposes transaction missing and flag-missing commands. However, nothing in the pack shows e-receipts being pulled from third-party integrations, and the matching mechanism and nudge targeting are only marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: evidence of e-receipt ingestion from integrations (e.g. email or merchant connectors), documented receipt-to-transaction matching logic, confirmation that nudges fire only for genuinely missing receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing

citations.quote: As soon as you swipe your card, Ramp captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories.
the receipt is captured automatically, coded to the correct GL account, and auto-approved because it's within policy — no expense report filed
Let Ramp send reminders for missing items or request repayments for you.
